desc: Ideation: identify monotonicity of f in each coordinate; choose between binary-search+counting vs best-first heap; heap approach selected (O(N log N + K log K)).
Implement the best-first heap solution (sort descending, heapq, visited set with integer encoding, pop K times, push +1-neighbors) with fast stdin/stdout I/O.

Verify correctness argument: f increasing in each coordinate (coefficients B_j+C_k, A_i+C_k, A_i+B_j all > 0); best-first on monotone grid yields descending order; indices beyond K never reached so no trim needed (optional trim to min(N,K) for smaller encode base).

Test on all three samples (expect 31, 30000, 689589940713840351) and stress-test against brute force on small random inputs; check edge cases N=1, K=1, K=N³, duplicates, large values (Python ints avoid overflow).
